items.text: No PMC water supply every Thursday; a second weekly cut day is being considered. Store water Wed night.
Katraj metro station work: heavy vehicles stopped at Navale Bridge, Shindewadi on trial.
Voter camps at all polling stations Oct 24–25. Register or change address before Oct 26.
SPPU warns Synergy School of Commerce isn't affiliated. Check affiliation before paying fees.
Police booked Rapido over unpermitted petrol bike taxis. Keep PMPML or metro as a backup.
Diwali: MSRTC plans 600+ special buses from Pimpri-Chinchwad, Swargate on Nov 4–7. Book early.
